stories.title: Create blog.ts utility module with category and related post queries
stories.description: Build TypeScript utilities to query blog posts by category, find related posts, and enumerate all published articles for sidebar widgets and SEO features.
acceptanceCriteria: blog.ts exports getPostsByCategory(category: string): Post[] function that filters and sorts blog posts by category field
blog.ts exports getRelatedPosts(slug: string, limit?: number): Post[] function matching by shared categories, excluding the source post
Functions successfully load and parse all markdown files from site/src/content/blog/ using gray-matter for frontmatter extraction

stories.title: Implement Article and BreadcrumbList schema.org markup on blog post pages
stories.description: Generate structured data for Article and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD on all blog post pages for enhanced SERP visibility, rich snippets, and Google News indexing.
acceptanceCriteria: Blog post page generateMetadata includes Article schema with headline, author, datePublished, dateModified, wordCount, and image URL properties in JSON-LD format
BreadcrumbList schema renders breadcrumb navigation path: Home > Blog > [Category] > [Post Title] with proper itemListElement structure
Both schemas output as <script type='application/ld+json'> in page <head> and validate against schema.org validation tool

stories.title: Extend sitemap.ts to include all blog post URLs with lastmod dates
stories.description: Dynamically generate XML sitemap entries for all published blog posts to ensure Google crawls and prioritizes blog content alongside main pages.
acceptanceCriteria: sitemap.ts reads from site/src/content/blog/ directory and generates URL objects for each .md file with pattern /blog/[slug]
Each blog URL entry includes lastmod timestamp extracted from markdown frontmatter date field in ISO 8601 format
Blog post URLs assigned priority 0.8 (below homepage 1.0, above resource pages 0.5) to signal medium importance

stories.title: Build Table of Contents component with anchor link navigation for blog posts
stories.description: Extract H2/H3 headings from blog markdown and render as sticky TOC sidebar for improved UX on long-form travel articles (1500+ words).
acceptanceCriteria: TableOfContents component accepts markdown content string and extracts all h2 and h3 headings with auto-generated anchor IDs (e.g., #why-backpack-jb)
TOC renders as sticky sidebar on desktop (top 20% viewport), collapsible drawer on mobile breakpoint, with active link highlight as user scrolls
Clicking any TOC link scrolls smoothly to matching heading with window.location.hash update for bookmark support

stories.title: Integrate JBNewsWidget component on homepage pulling from Bernama RSS feed
stories.description: Display latest Johor Bahru news items on homepage to increase freshness signals for Google crawler, improve repeat visitor engagement, and provide travel updates.
acceptanceCriteria: JBNewsWidget component fetches and parses RSS from Bernama RSS (https://www.bernama.com/feed/latest.rss) via /api/rss proxy endpoint
Widget displays top 3 latest news items with headline, publication date (relative time), source name, and external link (rel='noopener noreferrer')
Widget appears on homepage after hero section, includes 'View All JB News' link to /news page, and updates every 4 hours via ISR
